hyperscale_training.headline: Not yet — and the reason is missing evidence, not a bad site. 8 knockout checks cannot be evaluated at all because the factor each one reads is unmeasured; the regulatory, community domains have no data at all and drop out of the score; 17 unmeasured factors could each move the verdict across a threshold on its own; only 19% of the decision weight is measured. Profitability in particular is unanswerable here: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return. The verification queue is ordered by how much of the decision each answer settles.
hyperscale_training.profitability_basis: 5 of 5 cost inputs are unmeasured (Modeled 10-year TCO, Industrial retail power price, Large-load tariff availability, Land acquisition cost, Tax incentive package), so the score is a suitability screen, not a return.

blockers.title: Nothing measured in regulatory — all 7 factors dark
blockers.why: This domain carries weight 8 of 57 in this profile and has no values at all, so it is excluded from the score: the headline number is a weighted mean over the 5 domains that do have data, not over all 8. It also holds the input to 1 knockout check(s), which are therefore being decided blind.
blockers.resolve: Dispatch the regulatory analyst. Highest-swing factor in the domain is Accelerator export control exposure at 18 points.

blockers.title: Nothing measured in community — all 4 factors dark
blockers.why: This domain carries weight 6 of 57 in this profile and has no values at all, so it is excluded from the score: the headline number is a weighted mean over the 5 domains that do have data, not over all 8. It also holds the input to 1 knockout check(s), which are therefore being decided blind.
blockers.resolve: Dispatch the community analyst. Highest-swing factor in the domain is Organized opposition risk at 14 points.
blockers.owner: Public record — planning commission and board minutes

blockers.title: Substation available capacity is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 10 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Load-serving study or written statement of available capacity at the named substation, for the named load, in the named year.

blockers.title: Interconnection queue time to energization is unmeasured, and Credible power path to target load depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 10 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Queue position and cluster study schedule for a comparable request
blockers.owner: ISO/RTO interconnection queue, then the utility

blockers.title: Baseline water stress is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Will-serve letter or withdrawal permit precedent

blockers.title: Riverine and pluvial flood exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Site-specific study; global rasters are screening-grade only

blockers.title: Water rights and withdrawal permitting is unmeasured, and Water viability for the assumed cooling architecture depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 8 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Permit precedent for comparable industrial withdrawal in the same basin

blockers.title: Zoning and entitlement status is unmeasured, and Entitlement path exists depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
blockers.resolve: Zoning verification letter naming data center as permitted or conditional

blockers.title: Coastal flood and sea level rise exposure is unmeasured, and Flood exclusion depends on it
blockers.why: This gate is a knockout check and its input is missing, so its result is not evidence of anything. Resolving the factor moves the score by up to 6 points on its own.
